🇨🇳🤖 Kronos is an open-source foundation model designed specifically for financial candlestick data.

Rather than processing market charts as ordinary numbers, it turns raw OHLCV data into tokens and uses a decoder-only Transformer to forecast what could come next. Give it 400 candles, and it can predict the next 120.

One interesting feature is that developers can fine-tune both the tokenizer and prediction model with their own market data. The repository also provides multi-GPU training scripts, open weights on Hugging Face, and an MIT license.

This gives researchers, developers, and quantitative traders a more accessible way to experiment without building a financial model from the ground up.

However, the creators highlight an important limitation: the demo produces raw predictions, rather than a complete trading strategy.

Kronos is a tool for research and experimentation. Its forecasts do not guarantee accurate results or profitable trades.
